# Third-party skills: credits

These 3 skills come from Matt Pocock's public skills collection, https://github.com/mattpocock/skills. The files reference `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.
License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock. Full text in `LICENSE` in this folder.

Copied verbatim from `~/.agents/skills/`. Folder names and each SKILL.md frontmatter `description`:

- `grill-me`: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design.
- `grilling`: Grill the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea to stress-test their thinking.
- `research`: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture findings as a Markdown file in the repo.
